text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to give Inari One more experience in big races, I decide to sign her up for the Takarazuka Kinen, which White Lightning, Tamamo Cross, will also be running in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the track, Tamamo Cross seems like a completely different person from what she's like on campus. Under her intimidating presence, the curtains rise!
